provenance: Real IntegrationService runs over the I1 offline test world: real NebiusProvider adapter over a FAKE transport (synthetic reply), FAKE signing provider standing in for local Qwen, TEST keys (NOT FOR PRODUCTION), deterministic clock, temporary SQLite. No network, model, Nebius call or XRPL.
quote_provenance: configured DEMO prices in micro-tRLUSD (tRLUSD is a test token); not Nebius's billed price
accounting_note: Accounting settlement is not XRPL settlement. Drawn is Credence's record of verified spending, not confirmed loan principal. No XRPL transaction exists.

runs.title: Scenario A: general facility, accounting settled, retrieved, acknowledged
runs.summary: Both providers qualify; the cheaper Nebius offer is chosen; its Tier 1 delivery settles in Core accounting; the agent retrieves and acknowledges.

steps.note: agent-signed retrieve authorization accepted (TEST agent key, outside the UI)
agent-signed acknowledge authorization accepted; response bytes deleted

runs.title: Scenario B: controlled facility (Q8_0, Tier 2), accounting settled
runs.summary: Core rejects Nebius (PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED); the local Qwen offer is chosen; its Tier 2 delivery settles in Core accounting; the agent retrieves and acknowledges.

steps.note: agent-signed retrieve authorization accepted (TEST agent key, outside the UI)
steps.response_utf8: Synthetic response from local-qwen-provider to a 56-byte prompt.

steps.note: agent-signed acknowledge authorization accepted; response bytes deleted

runs.title: Rejected: no qualifying offer
runs.summary: The facility allows only Nebius but its procurement class requires Q8_0 at Tier 2. Core rejects both offers; nothing is reserved and no provider is called.

runs.title: Released: chosen provider not connected
runs.summary: Core reserves for Nebius, but this process has no Nebius connection. No delivery attempt exists, so Core releases the hold with an audit record.

runs.title: Unknown: provider failed after the attempt began
runs.summary: The attempt was recorded and claimed, then the Nebius adapter reported a provider execution error. Core cannot rule out a chargeable execution: unknown, never retried, the hold stays until expiry.
runs.harness: fake Nebius transport returns a reply without choices or usage

runs.title: Interrupted after the delivery attempt: unknown
runs.summary: The process dies after Core recorded the attempt. Recovery marks the attempt unknown (interrupted); nothing is charged or released.
runs.harness: simulated process death at after_attempt_begun (I1 test harness)

steps.note: IntegrationService.recover reconciled the journal with Core

runs.title: Interrupted before any attempt: released with audit
runs.summary: The process dies after Core reserved and before any delivery attempt. Recovery releases the hold (abandoned_before_execution).
runs.harness: simulated process death at after_reserve (I1 test harness)

steps.note: IntegrationService.recover reconciled the journal with Core

runs.title: Disputed: CHAIN_BROKEN at settlement
runs.summary: Evidence was captured, then Core's chain head moved. Settlement rejects CHAIN_BROKEN; the hold, the dispute and the exact evidence are kept.
runs.harness: simulated process death at after_evidence_stored, then Core's chain head moved out of band in SQLite (I1 test harness manipulation; cannot arise in the integrated path)

steps.note: IntegrationService.recover reconciled the journal with Core

runs.title: Late: delivery outlived the reservation
runs.summary: The provider returned after the 600-second hold expired. The evidence is kept as a late-delivery dispute and never settled.
runs.harness: the test clock jumps 630 s while the provider runs
